name: Nanao Taichi
source:
Member of the Autumn Troupe.

"A frivolous teenage boy who loves women and joined the company for his own simple reason of "I wanna be on stage and be popular!" He's always an upbeat life-of-the-party friendly type of person who'll shake his tail at anyone like a puppy. He looks up to the capable Banri and the scary-faced Juza and wants them to notice him, so he's not afraid to get involved with them."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Taichi_Nanao]A3! Wiki[/url]]
